system.description: Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the fi rst time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.
